goal: Run a vending-machine business for 365 simulated days and end with the highest possible net worth: bank balance, plus cash in the machine, plus unsold inventory at wholesale cost. It starts with $500 and pays a $2 fee every day.
view: At each step the agent receives a new prompt: the current state of the business (money, storage, machine slots, outstanding orders, headers of unread emails, the latest daily summary, recent transactions), its last 8 actions with each result cut to 260 characters, and the full result of its previous action. Nothing else is kept between steps.
past_runs_intro: One earlier run of the same agent, without a Register, on a different random seed: its first 60 simulated days. For each step, the time, the action and its result (long results are cut at 2,500 characters). After 60 days its net worth was $118.96; it started with $500.00.
